title: Reported Deepfake Influencers on TikTok Allegedly Used to Promote Fraudulent Wellness Products

behaviors.text: A network of TikTok accounts reportedly used AI-generated and deepfake influencer personas to promote wellness and beauty products through alleged deceptive advertising.
The content purportedly targeted vulnerable users and linked to unverified products before the accounts were removed.
Some personas were reportedly reused across multiple accounts with inconsistent backstories.
